units.title: First Conversations
units.description: Start with respectful greetings, goodbyes, and the first question Rachel will hear.

lessons.title: Greetings
lessons.summary: Say a respectful greeting, thank you, and goodbye in simple spoken Bengali.

lessons.title: How Are You?
lessons.summary: Ask how someone is and answer with simple friendly replies.

units.title: Names and People
units.description: Introduce yourself, ask names, and talk about family in romanized Bengali.

lessons.title: Introduce Yourself
lessons.summary: Say your name, ask a name, and say you are Rachel.

lessons.title: Family Words
lessons.summary: Learn simple family words and short sentences about people.

units.title: Food and Water
units.description: Ask for water, food, tea, and simple everyday needs.

lessons.title: Food and Water
lessons.summary: Say what you want using short food and drink phrases.

lessons.title: Hungry and Thirsty
lessons.summary: Say you are hungry, thirsty, or full in everyday Bengali.

units.title: Questions and Replies
units.description: Practice yes, no, common replies, and simple questions.

lessons.title: Yes, No, and Replies
lessons.summary: Use tiny replies that keep a conversation moving.

lessons.title: Simple Questions
lessons.summary: Ask what, where, and why with useful short phrases.

units.title: Feelings and Help
units.description: Say how you feel and ask for help in short spoken phrases.

lessons.title: Basic Feelings
lessons.summary: Talk about being happy, tired, sick, or worried.

lessons.title: Asking for Help
lessons.summary: Ask for help, slower speech, and simple understanding checks.

units.title: Visiting Someone’s Home
units.description: Warm phrases for arriving, sitting, thanking, and leaving politely.

lessons.title: Visiting a Home
lessons.summary: Learn what to say when you arrive at someone’s home and want to be polite.

lessons.title: Polite Home Phrases
lessons.summary: Use warm, simple phrases for tea, thanks, and saying goodbye.

units.title: Travel and Getting Around
units.description: Short phrases for directions, taxis, and finding your way.

lessons.title: Getting Around
lessons.summary: Learn simple direction phrases for moving around town.

lessons.title: Transport Help
lessons.summary: Ask for a taxi, station, or help when you are not sure where to go.

units.title: Daily Talk and Care
units.description: Small talk, affection, care, and urgent help in simple Bengali.

lessons.title: Questions and Small Talk
lessons.summary: Use quick everyday lines for weather, work, and casual conversation.

lessons.title: Care and Emergencies
lessons.summary: Say warm caring phrases and ask for serious help when needed.

units.title: Survival Basics
units.description: Start with polite essentials for quick travel moments in Peru.

lessons.title: Hello and Thanks
lessons.summary: Say hello, goodbye, please, and thank you in friendly travel Spanish.

lessons.title: Slowly and English?
lessons.summary: Ask for slower speech and say when you do not understand.

units.title: Introductions
units.description: Share who you are and keep a tiny conversation going.

lessons.title: My Name Is
lessons.summary: Introduce yourself and ask for someone’s name.

lessons.title: Traveling in Peru
lessons.summary: Say you are traveling in Peru and learning Spanish.

units.title: Directions and Getting Around
units.description: Find useful places and handle taxis or basic movement.

lessons.title: Where Is It?
lessons.summary: Ask where important travel places are.

lessons.title: Taxi and Directions
lessons.summary: Ask for a taxi, prices, and simple directions.

units.title: Food and Restaurants
units.description: Order simple food and handle common restaurant needs.

lessons.title: Ordering Food
lessons.summary: Ask for food and drinks politely.

lessons.title: Food Needs
lessons.summary: Ask about spice, meat, and allergies.

units.title: Hotels and Tours
units.description: Manage reservations, tour times, meeting points, and repeats.

lessons.title: Hotel Basics
lessons.summary: Check in and ask basic hotel questions.

lessons.title: Tour Questions
lessons.summary: Ask when to leave, where to meet, and request repetition.

units.title: Shopping and Markets
units.description: Shop politely in markets and ask about prices and payment.

lessons.title: Market Prices
lessons.summary: Ask prices and respond naturally while browsing.

lessons.title: Buying and Paying
lessons.summary: Ask for a discount and pay with cash or card.

units.title: Emergencies and Problems
units.description: Get help when something goes wrong.

lessons.title: Help and Health
lessons.summary: Say you need help, feel sick, or need a doctor.

lessons.title: Lost Documents
lessons.summary: Talk about lost items and ask for police or help.

units.title: Peru Travel Phrases
units.description: Use Peru-specific phrases for landmarks, tours, altitude, and photos.

lessons.title: Machu Picchu and Tours
lessons.summary: Ask about tickets, guides, entrances, and meeting points.

lessons.title: Altitude and Photos
lessons.summary: Handle altitude sickness, guides, markets, and photos politely.

units.title: Gentle Openings
units.description: Start with respectful greetings, wellness, names, and family words.

lessons.title: Greetings and Respect
lessons.summary: Say hello, thank you, sorry, please, and goodbye in gentle spoken Malayalam.

lessons.title: How Are You?
lessons.summary: Ask how someone is and answer with simple wellness phrases.

lessons.title: Names and Introductions
lessons.summary: Say your name, ask someone else's name, and explain that you know a little Malayalam.

lessons.title: Family and People
lessons.summary: Learn warm family words you may hear in homes and conversations.

units.title: Home and Daily Life
units.description: Practice food, home visits, daily phrases, and simple questions.

lessons.title: Food and Drinks
lessons.summary: Ask for water, tea, rice, and simple food help.

lessons.title: Visiting Someone's Home
lessons.summary: Use friendly home-visit phrases for sitting, eating, and entering politely.

lessons.title: Daily Conversation
lessons.summary: Use short everyday phrases for going, coming, waiting, and meeting again.

lessons.title: Questions and Small Talk
lessons.summary: Ask the tiny questions that keep a conversation moving.

lessons.title: Travel and Getting Around
lessons.summary: Ask for the bathroom, taxi help, a price, and where to stop.

units.title: Requests, Feelings, and Help
units.description: Build confidence with polite requests, needs, emergencies, and mixed review.

lessons.title: Polite Requests
lessons.summary: Ask someone to repeat, slow down, give something, or wait a moment.

lessons.title: Feelings and Needs
lessons.summary: Say how you feel with simple, useful everyday phrases.

lessons.title: Help and Emergencies
lessons.summary: Ask for help, a doctor, police, medicine, or help with a lost phone.

lessons.title: Review: Everyday Malayalam
lessons.summary: Review the most useful phrases for greeting, introducing yourself, eating, travel, and help.

units.title: History of Peru
units.description: A short story path for travelers: ancient cities, Inca roads, Cusco, Machu Picchu, Lima, independence, and living memory.

lessons.title: Ancient Peru Before the Inca
lessons.summary: Long before the Inca, Peru already had cities, temples, farms, trade, and sacred landscapes.

lessons.title: The Inca Empire
lessons.summary: The Inca built a mountain empire through roads, labor, storehouses, and careful organization.

lessons.title: Cusco as a Capital
lessons.summary: Before Peru was a country, Cusco was the sacred mountain capital of an empire.

lessons.title: Roads, Terraces, and Mountain Life
lessons.summary: Inca power came from learning how to live with steep land, altitude, and distance.

lessons.title: Machu Picchu
lessons.summary: Machu Picchu is famous because stone, mountain, water, and memory meet in one place.

lessons.title: Spanish Conquest
lessons.summary: The conquest of Peru came from timing, disease, civil war, alliances, violence, and ambition colliding.

lessons.title: Colonial Peru and Lima
lessons.summary: Lima became a colonial capital where Spanish power faced the vast, difficult Andes.

lessons.title: Independence from Spain
lessons.summary: Peru's independence came late and hard because Spanish power held on tightly in the Andes.

lessons.title: Indigenous Culture and Modern Peru
lessons.summary: Indigenous Peru is not only ancient; it is living, changing, and present today.

lessons.title: Peru Today: Cities, Tourism, and Memory
lessons.summary: Peru today asks travelers to see history in streets, food, museums, ruins, and living communities.
